text.tagline: Protects your monitor and your nervous system.
text.blurb: Calm your workplace. The Ambient Screen Saver Collection delivers presentation-ready ambient audio: pads, drones, bells and textures for lobbies, kiosks, waiting rooms and the quiet moments between meetings. Royalty-free for all your business communications.
intro: Welcome to the Ambient Screen Saver Collection, Millennium Edition, part of the Corvane Desktop Comfort Series. These sounds were designed to play while your screen saver runs: calm, slow and never distracting.
All sounds are royalty-free for business use. Leverage them in lobbies, trade-show kiosks, training videos and on-hold systems.
maker_note: At Corvane, we believe a calm workplace is a productive workplace. The Ambient Screen Saver Collection is part of the Corvane Desktop Comfort Series, trusted by thousands of organizations.
This product has been tested for Year 2000 compliance. See Y2K.TXT on this disc.
install: Insert the CD-ROM. In the Library tab, the disc appears as AMBIENT2000.
Open a folder and double-click a sound to load it.
For the Quick Start Guide, open QSTART.RTF in WordPad. The full User's Guide is AMBIENT.PDF.
